subject: Ops playbook draft: embedstream + function-calls pilot (summary & asks)
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.ai>
To: Liam Porter <liam@mindworks.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-02T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: EmbedStream pilot: ops playbook draft & clarified asks

Thanks again for the call today — appreciate the clarity on your use case. Quick recap and concrete asks so we can get a pilot SOW together.

Key pain points you shared
- Live triage throughput: short docs streaming in from agents with per-user latency target <= 250ms for top-1 responses.
- Ranking quality: embeddings + rerank needed for high precision on clinical note retrieval (top-3 precision).
- Proven ability to run function calls for structured extraction (FHIR-like JSON output) with strict schema validation.

Goals for the 6-week pilot
1) Demonstrate steady-state 200 qps with 95th percentile latency <= 400ms (streaming enabled). 
2) Deliver an embed + rerank flow that improves top-3 precision by >=12% vs baseline.
3) Surface structured function-call outputs validated against your schema (field-level pass rate >=98%).

Scope & integration notes
- SDK changes: client-side will need to enable streaming + resume tokens; we'll provide a small wrapper (js/py).
- Function calls: Redwood will host a validated schema and runtime validator; we expect you to run a light post-processor for mapping to EHR fields.
- KV caching: suggested TTL 120s for active sessions to reduce cold-starts.

Open questions (please confirm)
1) Which network topology for Private endpoint? (VPC peering vs. AWS PrivateLink)
2) Expected peak document length distribution (median, 95th percentile).
3) Does legal require redaction before sending to hosted endpoints, or can we run within your VPC?

Attachments: pilot-scope-v1.pdf (draft SOW), network-reqs.xlsx (initial connectivity checklist)

Next steps
- You: confirm topology and peak doc stats by EOD Wednesday.
- We: share SOW v1 and a secure upload link for sample documents by Friday.
- Schedule: Tech sync w/ your infra + CS — propose Wed 09/08 10:00 PT.

Thanks — will loop Monica from CS for onboarding runbook.

—
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ava@redwood.ai
From: Liam Porter <liam@mindworks.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, procurement@mindworks.ai
Date: 2026-09-02T17:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EmbedStream pilot: ops playbook draft & clarified asks

Thanks, Ava — good summary. A few answers inline and a couple of asks from procurement: 

- Network topology: we prefer AWS PrivateLink for this pilot to keep traffic within our account.
- Peak docs: median ~1.2k tokens, 95th ~9k tokens. Volume peaks midday ~140 qps; sustained expected ~60–80 qps.
- Legal: we can do redaction client-side but prefer VPC option for initial pilot.

Procurement note: can you provide a short SOW + security addendum and a ballpark for committed monthly spend (GPU-hours or $/token)? Procurement copied. They want the SOW + a SOC2 summary to start their review.

Also copied: Jenna (procurement) — she will coordinate contract and PO timing.

On the schema side, we can share a redacted sample set once you confirm the secure upload mechanism. Happy to schedule the tech sync on 09/08 10:00 PT; that time works.

—
Liam Porter
Head of AI Ops | MindWorks AI
liam@mindworks.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-03T08:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EmbedStream pilot prep — pricing and SLA notes

Quick internal note after Liam's reply:
- Pricing: baseline proposal = $12k/month committed for Dedicated pilot capacity (estimate covers 200 qps steady with streaming + 2x burst). We should prepare a 6-week pilot SOW priced pro-rata.
- SLA ask: they want SOC2 summary + network topology doc. Monica, can you assemble the lightweight security packet (SOC2 snapshot + data flow diagram) and I will draft the SOW pricing sections.
- On technical: confirm we can support PrivateLink for initial pilot. If not, propose VPC peering fallback.

Also: flagging potential scope creep on the function-call validator — we should scope to schema validation only and avoid full ETL mapping in the pilot.

—
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai

Date: 2026-09-03T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EmbedStream pilot: ops playbook draft & clarified asks

Thanks, Liam & Jenna — noted and next steps below. Quoting key points for the record:

> Network topology: AWS PrivateLink preferred.
> Peak docs: median ~1.2k tokens, 95th ~9k tokens; peak ~140 qps.
> Legal: prefer VPC for initial pilot; will send redacted samples once upload channel is confirmed.

Action items / timeline
- Redwood (Ava/Monica): share SOW v1 (6-week pro-rata) + SOC2 snapshot + network-reqs by Fri 09/04 EOD. (Attachments: pilot-scope-v1.pdf, network-reqs.xlsx)
- MindWorks (Liam/Jenna): confirm PO/contract timeline and provide a secure S3 endpoint or preferred upload method for sample docs.
- Tech sync: Wed 09/08 10:00 PT (calendar invite to follow).

Pilot constraints we are locking in (to avoid scope creep)
- Function-call runtime will validate schema and return structured JSON; full field-mapping/ETL out of scope for pilot.
- Rerank will be evaluated on your annotated testset; we need the labeled baseline before the tech sync.

Links: SOW draft (shared internally) — https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-playbook-draft
